elements.name: ypy-csrf
elements.description: Not an element: the `name` of the `<meta name="ypy-csrf" content="TOKEN">` tag that carries the CSRF token. `data-header` names the request header (default `X-CSRF-Token`).

headers.name: YPY-CSRF
headers.description: A new CSRF token. A same-origin response that carries it replaces the content of the `ypy-csrf` meta tag (created when missing), and the next request sends it.

events.name: ypy:csrf:missing
events.description: An unsafe (not GET or HEAD) request to the page's own origin is about to leave without a CSRF token: the `ypy-csrf` meta tag is missing or empty. Cancel it to silence the console warning, which is shown once per URL. The request is still sent.
